title: gate
description: The gate job of the proof run workflow hears Proof run attested: it needs the attest job, so on a pull request it runs once the attestation is kept, also when the suites or the attest job fail, and not when the run is cancelled. It checks out the pull request's base commit into a folder of its own, builds assure there from the base's cmd/assure and internal/assure, with workspace mode off and with no cache restored, makes Lathe and the built binary read-only, and runs that binary in the change's checkout with the Lathe the workflow builds from LATHE_REF: assure gate change for the pull request's head against its base, which measures the base before the change, and reads the attestation from GitHub's store and verifies it. No code of the change's tree runs: Lathe reads its spec, whose product checks are queries that Lathe runs. When the gate cannot run, such as when Lathe or assure does not build, the job fails with a line that says the gate did not run.
